items.title: 5.4 Determination of Young's modulus of a wire (wire ka Young's modulus maloom karna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.4 with Fig. 5.4 (PDF 97-98).

blocks.text: Wire ki shakal mein kisi material ka Young's modulus experiment se zyada tar Searle's apparatus se maloom kiya jata hai (Fig. 5.4).

blocks.alt: Ek support se do taar latakte hain: baen taraf reference taar CD aur daen taraf test taar AB. Har ek par lakri ka frame hai, baen F2 aur daen F1, jo cross bars se jure hain. Frames ke beech spirit level F1 par lage micrometer screw par tika hai. Frames ke neeche hooks par baen taraf constant weight slab aur daen taraf slotted weights wala bhari hanger latakta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.4: Searle ka apparatus (kitab ki Figure 5.4 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Is mein ek hi material ki do wires hoti hain, lambai aur diameter dono barabar: ek auxiliary ya reference wire (comparison ke liye wire) aur ek test wire (jis par experiment hota hai). Dono ek rigid support (mazboot sahara) se latakti hain. Neeche ke siron par dono horizontal bars (frames F₁ aur F₂) se juri hain. Reference wire ke frame ke hook par ek constant (fixed) weight aur test wire par hanger latkaya jata hai, taake wire tani rahe aur us mein kinks (bal) na hon.
